body: 2026-10-16. A login default can be set on a profile (`login:`), on a provider default, and per terminal (AGX_LOGIN env + the generated `aglogin` shell function). Why: each covers a real case (alias default, 'everything on account A this week', one terminal) and the cost is two YAML keys on one code path plus one env var.
title: Logins D2: defaults at profile, provider and terminal scope
